messages:
maya: heads up — customer X asked for per-route error-budget alerts surfaced in the console. they want to get paged only when a route is burning >3% in 15m, not for every tiny blip :grimacing:
\
aaron: +1. main UX question: do we show the raw SLO burn metric or an auto-configured alert card with suggested thresholds? :thinking:
\
li: suggest we show both. card with a recommended default + a collapsible raw timeseries. defaults should be conservative to avoid noise.
\
samir: important: routing/contacts. enterprise customers want route->team mapping so alerts go to the owning oncall. console needs a binding UI for route tags -> notification policy.
\
maya: agreed. also quota alerts are different — they should be immediate when we hit 90% quota but error budget is tolerable for a bit. separate templates?
\
jess: from product: keep it simple for self-serve. two presets: "noise-averse" and "sensitive". default = noise-averse. let advanced users flip to sensitive and tune window/threshold.
\
aaron: technical constraints: our backend emits per-route burn as a percent every 10s, but some routes have low qps so percent jumps are meaningless. we need min-traffic filter (e.g., only alert if >5rps or >50 reqs in window).
\
li: +1 on min-traffic. propose rule: require >=50 requests in 15m AND burn >=3% to fire. that reduces false positives for low-volume routes.
\
samir: for paging behavior, add an escalation policy: first notify slack channel for team, then page after sustained 10m. might also have an auto-snooze if an ongoing deploy tag is attached.
\
maya: UX mock: show a single card on route page: title "Error budget burn" with toggle "Enable alerting" -> dropdown presets -> advanced -> edit json. inline help explaining min-traffic and escalation.
\
jess: can we add a quick "apply to all routes with tag X"? customers will want to apply a policy across many routes.
\
aaron: doable. backend accepts a policy apply API. need console batch-apply UI and confirmation modal. warn about paging spikes.
\
li: sample policy payload for backend (for engineers):
```json
{
  "selector": { "tag": "payments" },
  "alert": {
    "type": "error_budget_burn",
    "window": "15m",
    "threshold_percent": 3,
    "min_requests": 50,
    "escalation": { "notify": "team_channel", "page_after": "10m" },
    "snooze_on_deploy": true
  }
}
```
\
samir: love that. small nit: rename "page_after" -> "page_if_sustained_for" for clarity.
\
maya: action items: 1) frontend mockups for card + batch-apply (jess + maya) 2) backend API schema review + min-traffic filter (aaron + li) 3) oncall routing UI (samir) 4) draft help text for noise-averse default (jess).
\
jess: I'll start mock today, will post frames here :eyes:
\
alert-bot: deploybot: canary finished on inference-console/v2 — no errors in canary window :white_check_mark:
\
maya: thanks — moving to design async. if we can get a first-pass API schema by EOD tomorrow that helps the UI iteration.
\
aaron: I'll sketch the schema and minimal validation rules, drop a PR link when ready.
\
li: SGTM. also let's add telemetry: when a user flips preset we should record that event for later tuning of defaults.
\
samir: and metric to track: "alerts fired per 1000 routes per week" so we can measure noise.
\
maya: perfect. keep thread updates light — we can consolidate design + API PRs into a single RFC later. :thumbsup:
